title: 同商品跨供应商采购价差
context: 管理层希望看到同品不同供应商的采购单价差异。
requirements: 2025年非取消采购行，同商品同供应商采购金额/订购量为加权单价；只比较有至少两家供应商商品；输出供应商加权价、最低价及相对最低价的溢价率。
commonError: 对单位价格直接AVG没有反映采购数量权重。
executionSteps: 按每商品供应商求加权价
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents)*1.0/SUM(quantity_ordered) avg_price FROM v_po_lines WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id,supplier_id), b AS (SELECT *,MIN(avg_price) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id) low,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id) n FROM a) SELECT product_id,supplier_id,ROUND(avg_price,2) weighted_price_cents,ROUND(low,2) low_price_cents,ROUND(100.0*(avg_price-low)/NULLIF(low,0),2) premium_pct FROM b WHERE n>=2 ORDER BY product_id,premium_pct,supplier_id
